# Del Mar Villa LLC

> > Del Mar Villa LLC is a 26,000 sq ft Italian Chateau-style vacation rental and bed & breakfast situated on 46 acres in Dundee, Oregon Wine Country.

Located in the Pacific Northwest's renowned wine region, Del Mar Villa offers luxury accommodations in a distinctive Italian villa setting. The property previously operated under StayLux property management before transitioning to independent operations.
